aiEffortTracker.mcpServer.enabled.description: Offer the read-only 'AI Effort Tracker usage insights' MCP server to Copilot agent mode, so you can ask an AI how to optimize your credit usage. It reads the tracker's local data and, only when asked, short prompt excerpts from Copilot's local debug logs.

aiEffortTracker.sessions.showTitles.description: Show chat titles (the name VS Code shows for a chat, or its first prompt) and prompt excerpts in the dashboard's Sessions tab. They are read from VS Code's local files on demand and never stored by the tracker. Turn off when sharing your screen.

aiEffortTracker.handoff.includePrompts.description: Include the first and last prompt of the chat (read from the local Copilot debug log, never stored) in the New Chat with Handoff prompt.

enumDescriptions: Round each day to the nearest quarter hour
Round each day to the nearest half hour
aiEffortTracker.timesheet.rounding.description: Default rounding of the Timesheet tab and its CSV export (can be switched in the tab).

aiEffortTracker.away.prompt.description: When you come back after being away from VS Code (idle, other app, meeting, sleep), ask whether to count the time as meeting, review/thinking or other work, and log it as a time entry. Time another VS Code window was active is not asked about.

aiEffortTracker.away.minMinutes.description: Only ask about away periods of at least this many minutes.

aiEffortTracker.away.maxMinutes.description: Do not ask about away periods longer than this (overnight, weekends).

aiEffortTracker.budget.alerts.description: Notify once when a work item crosses a budget threshold (time, credits or money). Thresholds re-arm when consumption drops below them, for example after raising the estimate.

aiEffortTracker.budget.showStatusBar.description: Show the current branch's work-item budget in the status bar, e.g. "WI 1761: 64% · 3.2h left".

aiEffortTracker.budget.thresholds.description: Budget alert thresholds in percent of the most-used budget dimension.

aiEffortTracker.budget.creditsPerEstimat.description: Default credit budget per estimated hour when a work item has no explicit credit budget (0 = no derived credit budget). A project can override it with "Set Project Rates".

aiEffortTracker.nudges.enabled.description: Show live nudges while you chat when the Copilot debug log shows a costly pattern (model switch, expired cache, large context, light turns on a premium model, too many tools). Uses token/credit metadata only, never prompt content.

aiEffortTracker.nudges.showLiveChatCost.description: Show the running credits of the current chat in the status bar (e.g. "chat 312 cr · 9.4/call").

aiEffortTracker.nudges.modelSwitch.description: Nudge when switching models mid-chat re-sent the whole conversation without cache.

aiEffortTracker.nudges.idleCache.description: Nudge when a pause let the prompt cache expire and a large context was billed again.

aiEffortTracker.nudges.contextGrowth.description: Nudge when the chat's context grows past aiEffortTracker.nudges.contextTokens.

aiEffortTracker.nudges.lightTurns.description: Nudge when several consecutive read-only/Q&A turns ran on a model at least twice as expensive as an available alternative.

aiEffortTracker.nudges.toolBloat.description: Nudge (at most once a day) when many tools are offered per request or the model had to search for tools.

aiEffortTracker.nudges.contextTokens.description: Context size (input tokens of the main chat) that triggers the context-growth nudge. It fires again each time the context doubles (e.g. 150K, 300K, 600K).

aiEffortTracker.nudges.cacheMinTokens.description: Minimum uncached context (tokens) for model-switch and expired-cache nudges.

aiEffortTracker.nudges.toolCount.description: Tools offered per request that trigger the tool nudge.

aiEffortTracker.nudges.lightTurnCount.description: Consecutive light turns on a premium model before the light-turns nudge.

aiEffortTracker.nudges.cooldownMinutes.description: Minimum minutes before the model-switch nudge repeats for the same chat. Expired-cache and light-turn nudges show once per chat, the tool nudge at most once a day, and any two nudges are at least 10 minutes apart.

aiEffortTracker.idleThresholdSeconds.description: While VS Code is focused, switch to Idle after this many seconds with no editor activity (typing, cursor moves, AI writes).

aiEffortTracker.codingActiveSeconds.description: Keep counting 'Human Coding' for this many seconds after your last keystroke.

aiEffortTracker.aiActiveSeconds.description: Keep counting 'AI Generating' for this many seconds after the last Copilot/agent write.

aiEffortTracker.baselineLocPerMinute.description: Your baseline hand-coding speed (lines of code per minute) used to estimate time saved by AI. Tip: run 'AI Effort Tracker: Set Developer Profile' to pre-fill this from a seniority preset (still fully editable).

enumDescriptions: Custom — no auto-fill; use whatever 'baselineLocPerMinute' is set to
aiEffortTracker.seniority.description: Your developer seniority. Presets pre-fill 'baselineLocPerMinute' with a sensible hand-coding speed (junior=3, mid=5, senior=8 lines/min) that you can still adjust. 'custom' leaves your baseline untouched. Set this via 'AI Effort Tracker: Set Developer Profile'.

aiEffortTracker.baselineLocPerMinuteByCa.description: Optional per-category baseline hand-coding speeds (lines/min), e.g. { "code": 5, "spec": 8, "docs": 12 }. When a category has no value, the flat 'baselineLocPerMinute' is used. The generated-value/ROI math currently uses the flat baseline as the effective input; per-category values are read by the profile resolver for future use.

aiEffortTracker.hourlyRateUsd.description: Developer hourly cost in USD, used to value the time saved (ROI). Legacy/global default cost rate: a project without its own hourly cost, and no 'defaultHourlyCostRate' set, falls back to this.

aiEffortTracker.defaultHourlyCostRate.description: Global default for what one developer hour COSTS, used for projects that don't set their own hourly cost. When unset, falls back to the legacy 'hourlyRateUsd'. Precedence: project setting > this > hourlyRateUsd.

aiEffortTracker.defaultHourlySellRate.description: Global default for what one developer hour is BILLED/SOLD for, used for projects that don't set their own sell rate. When unset, sold value is left unresolved (null) rather than assumed. Precedence: project setting > this.

aiEffortTracker.currency.description: Currency the rate/ROI figures are expressed in (e.g. 'USD', 'EUR'). A project may override this in its settings.

aiEffortTracker.creditCostPerUnit.description: Money cost per 1 credit / premium request, used to fold AI credit spend into project cost. When unset, falls back to the legacy 'usdPerCredit'. Precedence: project setting > this > usdPerCredit.

aiEffortTracker.usdPerCredit.description: USD cost per Copilot premium request (credit), used to estimate AI spend.

aiEffortTracker.dailyActiveGoalMinutes.description: Your daily focus goal in minutes, shown as a progress ring on the Focus tab.

aiEffortTracker.autoCaptureCredits.description: Legacy premium-request weight estimates. Used only when captureDebugLogs and autoCaptureRealCredits are disabled, with no credit-import folder. These are not usage-based AI credit charges.

aiEffortTracker.captureDebugLogs.description: Read recorded per-model-call AI credit charges and successful edit details from this workspace's Copilot debug-logs. Disables competing live estimators and automatic export-folder imports to prevent duplicate charges. Existing unsynced history is not auto-attributed: use Import Copilot Debug Session to choose its branch. Missing charges remain unknown, not estimated. Reload the window after changing.

aiEffortTracker.autoCapturePollSeconds.description: How often (seconds) to check Copilot usage logs. Minimum 3 for debug-log/chat-session capture; minimum 5 for legacy request weights.

aiEffortTracker.autoCaptureRealCredits.description: Legacy chat-session token estimator, used only when captureDebugLogs is disabled and no creditImportFolder is configured. Token estimates upgrade to a recorded charge when available. Debug-log capture is preferred because it includes internal agent rounds.

aiEffortTracker.creditImportFolder.description: Legacy folder for Chat Debug JSON exports. Automatic folder imports run only when captureDebugLogs is disabled, and disable the live estimators. Imports use recorded charges, deduplicate known request identities, and preserve unrelated/manual history. Manual Import Real Credits remains available. Historical exports are attributed to the chosen/current branch; prefer Import Copilot Debug Session for explicit session selection.

aiEffortTracker.aiuRatesOverride.description: Optional overrides for the per-model AIU rate table used to ESTIMATE real-credit cost from tokens (issue #59). Keys are model-family stems matched by substring against the model id (longest match wins), e.g. 'claude-opus', 'gpt-5', 'gemini'. Each value is { inputNanoAiuPerToken, outputNanoAiuPerToken } in nano-AIU per token (1 AIU = 1e9 nano-AIU). Unset families fall back to the built-in table, then a safe default; the exact total_nano_aiu capture always overrides an estimate when available.

aiEffortTracker.autoCreditDefaultMultipl.description: Estimated premium-request credits to attribute to an auto-captured model request when the model is not listed in premiumRequestMultipliers.

aiEffortTracker.premiumRequestMultiplier.description: Estimated premium-request credits per auto-captured model request, matched by substring against the model id (longest match wins). Set a model to 0 to treat it as included/background and skip it.

aiEffortTracker.githubToken.description: GitHub personal access token (needs 'manage_billing:copilot' scope for Copilot Metrics API)

aiEffortTracker.githubOrg.description: GitHub organization name for Copilot Metrics API (e.g. 'myorg')

aiEffortTracker.githubRepo.description: GitHub repo in 'owner/repo' format for repo-level Copilot Metrics (e.g. 'myorg/myrepo')

aiEffortTracker.categoryRules.extensions.markdownDescription: Categorize files by extension. Values: `programming`, `specification`, `documentation`, `translation`, `deployment`, `config`, `other`. Keys may be `al`, `.al`, or `*.al`. XLF, XLIFF, PO, POT and RESX default to translation; translation lines are tracked separately and excluded from productivity/generated-value estimates. These rules override built-in defaults.

aiEffortTracker.categoryRules.folders.markdownDescription: Categorize files by folder/path. Keys are folder names or glob patterns (e.g. `docs`, `src/specs`, `Translations`); values are one of `programming`, `specification`, `documentation`, `translation`, `deployment`, `config`, `other`. Use translation for JSON or other localization files in a dedicated folder. Folder rules take precedence over extension rules.

aiEffortTracker.review.enabled.description: Track which changed lines you have reviewed (gutter marks, CodeLens, Review view, status bar).

aiEffortTracker.review.showDecorations.description: Show review marks in the gutter and overview ruler: reviewed (green), issue (red), changed but not reviewed yet (amber).

aiEffortTracker.review.codeLens.description: Show "Mark reviewed" / "Flag issue" CodeLens above unreviewed changes and a progress line at the top of changed files.

aiEffortTracker.review.showStatusBar.description: Show the review progress of the current branch in the status bar.

aiEffortTracker.review.exclude.description: Glob patterns (relative to the repository root) of changed files that never need review, e.g. lock files and generated output.

aiEffortTracker.review.baseRef.description: Branch, tag or commit to review against. Empty = the merge-base with the default branch (origin/HEAD, main or master). The command "Review: Set Review Baseline…" overrides this per branch.

enumDescriptions: By effort category (your category rules), then folder
Flat list, most lines left to review first
aiEffortTracker.review.groupBy.description: How the AI Effort: Review view groups changed files.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No changed lines to review on this branch.
Changes since the merge-base with the default branch appear here, including AI edits you already committed.
